description: Apply color token fixes across components and implement the Scanner page two-column redesign. Depends on FEAT-001 (theme variables must be in place first). This FEAT covers: (1) Scanner column ratio fix in Upload.jsx and GuestUpload.jsx — change col-lg-5/7 to col-lg-4/8, remove distracting float-subtle animation from upload card, fix GuestUpload hardcoded RGBA input backgrounds; (2) Fix hardcoded neon alert colors in DietPlanner.jsx; (3) Fix glassmorphism blur in DigitalTwin.jsx toolbar and replace hardcoded dark RGBA colors with theme variables; (4) Fix App.jsx Vitals Index accent color reference from removed --accent-orange/--accent-red to --accent-amber/--accent-coral.
steps: Read frontend/src/pages/Upload.jsx before editing. Change both column divs: 'col-lg-5 col-md-5' → 'col-lg-4 col-md-4', and 'col-lg-7 col-md-7' → 'col-lg-8 col-md-8'. Remove 'float-subtle' from the left scanner glass-card className.

Read frontend/src/pages/GuestUpload.jsx before editing. Apply the same column ratio change: col-lg-5/7 → col-lg-4/8. Remove 'float-subtle' from the left panel glass-card. Replace the 4 occurrences of hardcoded input styles inside the Guest Identification Info card: change background:'rgba(255,255,255,0.04)' → background:'var(--input-surface)' and border:'1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1)' → border:'1px solid var(--border-color)'.

Read frontend/src/pages/DietPlanner.jsx before editing. In the success alert div (near top of return), replace color:'#00f5a0' → color:'var(--accent-green)', background:'rgba(0,200,130,0.12)' → background:'var(--status-normal-bg)', border:'1px solid rgba(0,200,130,0.3)' → border:'1px solid var(--status-normal-border)'. In the error alert div, replace color:'#ff6080' → color:'var(--accent-coral)', background:'rgba(255,50,80,0.1)' → background:'var(--status-danger-bg)', border:'1px solid rgba(255,50,80,0.3)' → border:'1px solid var(--status-danger-border)'.

Read frontend/src/pages/DigitalTwin.jsx before editing. In the view-mode toggle toolbar div (the one with position:'absolute', top:'12px', left:'12px'), find the inner container with backdropFilter:'blur(8px)' and: (a) remove backdropFilter:'blur(8px)' entirely, (b) replace background:'rgba(15,23,42,0.88)' with background:'var(--bg-form)', (c) replace border:'1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12)' with border:'1px solid var(--border-color)'. For each mode button, replace the active state background:'rgba(255,255,255,0.15)' → background:'var(--bg-upload)', active border:'1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.22)' → border:'1px solid var(--primary-accent)', active color:'#ffffff' → color:'var(--text-primary)', inactive color:'rgba(255,255,255,0.55)' → color:'var(--text-secondary)'.

Read frontend/src/App.jsx before editing. In the Sidebar component, find the line: const themeAccentColor = scoreNum >= 85 ? 'var(--accent-green)' : scoreNum >= 70 ? 'var(--accent-orange)' : 'var(--accent-red)'. Change to: const themeAccentColor = scoreNum >= 85 ? 'var(--accent-green)' : scoreNum >= 70 ? 'var(--accent-amber)' : 'var(--accent-coral)'. Also update the mobile nav dropdown style from background:'var(--bg-surface)' to background:'var(--bg-form)' so it has depth differentiation from the page background.
acceptance_criteria: On the Scanner page (/upload), the left upload column is narrower and the right result panel is wider
The left upload card no longer floats/bobs up and down
Guest upload inputs (Name, Email fields) use the theme input surface color instead of nearly-transparent white
In DietPlanner, success and error alerts use theme-colored backgrounds and text (no hardcoded neon hex values)
In DigitalTwin view-mode toggle, the toolbar background matches the form surface color with no blur effect
In the sidebar, the Vitals Index ring uses amber for moderate scores and coral for unstable scores
verification: Navigate to /upload — confirm wider right panel, no floating animation on left card
Log out and navigate to /upload as guest — confirm identification inputs match theme colors
Navigate to /diet — generate a plan, confirm success/error alerts use muted blue-green/coral colors
Navigate to /digital-twin — confirm the view-mode toolbar has no blur behind it
If logged in as Patient with health score, check sidebar Vitals Index color mapping
findings: All 5 steps applied cleanly. Upload.jsx and GuestUpload.jsx: left column narrowed to col-lg-4, right column widened to col-lg-8, float-subtle animation removed from left glass-card. GuestUpload.jsx: 4 hardcoded RGBA input styles replaced with var(--input-surface) and var(--border-color). DietPlanner.jsx: neon #00f5a0/#ff6080 alert colors replaced with --accent-green/--accent-coral and status bg/border variables. DigitalTwin.jsx: view-mode toolbar backdropFilter:blur(8px) removed, rgba(15,23,42,0.88) → var(--bg-form), rgba(255,255,255,0.12) border → var(--border-color), active button rgba colors → var(--bg-upload)/var(--primary-accent)/var(--text-primary)/var(--text-secondary). App.jsx: Vitals Index themeAccentColor updated from --accent-orange/--accent-red to --accent-amber/--accent-coral, mobile nav dropdown background changed from var(--bg-surface) to var(--bg-form). Build: passed with 0 errors.
